definitions.gloss: high praise, rave review, great acclaim
definitions.explanation: Extremely enthusiastic praise or approval. Used when something receives overwhelmingly positive reviews or reactions.

examples.japanese: {批評家|ひひょうか}たちが{絶賛|ぜっさん}した。
examples.english: The critics gave it rave reviews.

examples.japanese: {絶賛|ぜっさん}{発売中|はつばいちゅう}の{新商品|しんしょうひん}をお{試|ため}しください。
examples.english: Please try our new product, now on sale to great acclaim.

examples.japanese: この{映画|えいが}は{海外|かいがい}でも{絶賛|ぜっさん}され、{数々|かずかず}の{賞|しょう}を{受|う}けた。
examples.english: This film was highly acclaimed overseas as well and won numerous awards.

notes:
USAGE:
Very commonly used in advertising and marketing Japanese. The phrase {絶賛|ぜっさん}{発売中|はつばいちゅう} (now on sale to great acclaim) and {絶賛|ぜっさん}{公開中|こうかいちゅう} (now showing to great acclaim) are standard promotional expressions. In more neutral contexts, it genuinely conveys exceptional praise.

GRAMMAR:
Functions as a noun and a する verb: {絶賛|ぜっさん}する (to highly praise). Often appears in passive: {絶賛|ぜっさん}される (to be highly praised).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {絶賛|ぜっさん}{発売中|はつばいちゅう}: on sale to great acclaim
- {絶賛|ぜっさん}{公開中|こうかいちゅう}: now showing to great acclaim
- {絶賛|ぜっさん}の{声|こえ}: voices of high praise
- {絶賛|ぜっさん}される: to be highly acclaimed
